name: Rhonas the Indomitable
oracle_text:
Deathtouch, indestructible
Rhonas can't attack or block unless you control another creature with power 4 or greater.
{2}{G}: Another target creature gets +2/+0 and gains trample until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Rhonas can't attack or block unless you control another creature with power 4 or greater.

needs.what: a self-only attack/block restriction (cant_attack + cant_block) whose 'unless' condition is checked at declare-attackers/declare-blockers time against the CURRENT, fully derived power of other creatures you control (pumps, +1/+1 counters, anthems included), e.g. a restriction condition {"exists": {"controller": "you", "types": ["Creature"], "exclude_self": true, "power": {"op": ">=", "value": 4}}} evaluated with derived characteristics
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The static cant_attack/cant_block with a static `condition` of `not`+`exists` loads, but static conditions are evaluated in characteristics._static_active before any layer applies and the `power` filter reads _base_pt (printed power only). So a 3-power creature pumped by Rhonas's own {2}{G} ability (+2/+0), or one with +1/+1 counters or an anthem, would not let Rhonas attack -- the card's central interaction silently breaks, and a printed 4-power creature shrunk below 4 would still enable it. That is an approximation, not the printed rule.
